versions.changelog:
Initial release of pipeline-helper-7772.

- Installs shell integration by appending an idempotent activity-logging line to the specified shell profile.
- Reads configuration from scripts/app.json to determine profile and marker file names.
- Ensures duplicate lines are not appended on subsequent runs.
- Requires --init for first-time configuration setup.
- No network access; all operations are performed locally.
